`dvc exp pull <refname>` error: ERROR: unexpected error - 'str' object has no attribute 'baseline_sha'
# Bug Report

## Issue name

When there are multiple experiments pushed to a git remote with the same name, trying to use `dvc pull` instructs to use the full refname to decide which one to pull. Doing so outputs an error, although the experiment seems to have been pulled correctly.

## Description

For example:
```console
$ dvc exp pull origin RandomForest
ERROR: Ambiguous name 'RandomForest' refers to multiple experiments in '{git_remote}'. Use full refname to pull one of the following:

	refs/exps/0a/57c2dab7898260bfdecce271f6b7f9cc22cd6b/RandomForest
	refs/exps/8e/96906ff946d98335625c8525d0dc0b54474665/RandomForest
```

Doing so prints an error:
```console
$ dvc exp pull origin refs/exps/0a/57c2dab7898260bfdecce271f6b7f9cc22cd6b/RandomForest
ERROR: unexpected error - 'str' object has no attribute 'baseline_sha'                                                                                                     
...[truncated]...
